Push dowels into each tier that carries: Tura dowels cikin kowane matakin da ke ɗaukar nauyi, yi musu alama a tsayin biredi, yanke su iri ɗaya, sannan tura su baya. Nauyin sai ya wuce ta allunan zuwa ganga, ba cake ba. Isar da sanyi, akwati, lebur, cikin mota mai sanyi.

For example, Hauwa in Abuja costs a 20 c: Misali, Hauwa da ke Abuja ta sayi kek din vanilla mai Layer Layer 20 cm tare da kirim mai tsami na Swiss meringue.
Farashin da aka zaci. Yi amfani da naku rasit.
Many skilled bakers stay busy but broke,: Yawancin ƙwararrun masu yin burodi suna shagaltuwa amma sun karye, saboda suna yin ƙima. Nemo farashin kowane gram na kowane sashi: abin da kuka biya, raba ta gram a cikin fakitin. Ana ɗaukar waɗannan farashin, don nuna hanyar.
Hauwa's ingredients come to about 12,000: Kayan Hauwa sun kai kimanin naira dubu goma sha biyu. Man shanu shine mafi girman farashi.
Packaging, the board, drum and box, abou: Marufi, allo, ganga da akwati, kusan 3,500.
Her share of gas, power and water, about: Kasonta na iskar gas, wuta da ruwa, kusan 2,000.
And her own labour, 5 hours at 1,500 nai: Ita kuma aikinta na awa 5 akan naira 1,500 a awa daya, wato 7,500. Jimlar farashin: Naira 25,000.
She adds a 30 percent markup, for a pric: Ta kara da kashi 30 cikin dari, akan farashin naira 32,500. Ribar da ta samu shine 7,500, wanda kusan kashi 23 ne kawai na farashin. Don haka rangwamen kashi 10 zai rage mata riba da sama da kashi 40. Bayar da ƙarin ƙima kafin yanke farashin.
Sugar, decorations and payments: Sugar, kayan ado da biyan kuɗi

Hot sugar goes well past 150 degrees and: Sugar mai zafi ya wuce digiri 150 kuma yana manne da fata. Saka safar hannu masu jure zafi kuma a kiyaye yara. Idan ya taba fata, kwantar da shi a karkashin ruwa mai gudu na akalla minti 20, kuma a sami taimakon likita don mummunar kuna.

And confirm every payment inside your ba: Kuma tabbatar da kowane biyan kuɗi a cikin app ɗin bankin ku. Faɗakarwar karya yaudara ce ta gama gari.

For every order, send a written brief an: Ga kowane oda, aika rubutaccen taƙaitaccen bayani kuma tabbatar da shi. Ɗauki ajiya, sau da yawa 50 zuwa 70 bisa dari.
Label each cake with storage advice, a b: Sanya kowane kek tare da shawarwarin ajiya, mafi kyawun kwanan wata da allergens kamar alkama, kwai, madara da goro.
And keep a weekly calendar, so you never: Kuma kiyaye kalanda na mako-mako, don haka ba za ku taɓa karɓar fiye da tanda da sa'o'in ku ba.

To remember. Give fondant a firm base. W: Don tunawa. Ba fondant tushe mai ƙarfi. Yi aikin hidima daga yankin bene. Taimakawa kowane mataki tare da allo da dowels.
